title: Matamshi Bora (Theme 1: Nyumbani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the one feature that separates p/b, t/d, k/g na ch/j and checks the meaning of the word before writing it.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels and reads open syllables (ba, be, bi, bo, bu).
floor.question: Soma: ta-mu

representations: a hand on the throat to feel the voice (or the lips for a nasal)
a picture for each meaning (sweet, blood)
steps: Think of the meaning in the sentence.
Write it and read it back.
contexts: a word game in the playground

board.do: Point at the first letter of each word.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes both words under their pictures and says each one.

misconceptions.ask: Neno "tamu" lina maana gani, na "damu" lina maana gani?
misconceptions.repair: "tamu" ni sweet; "damu" ni blood. Sauti moja hubadilisha maana.
Neno lenye maana ya "a coat" ni "koti". "goti" lina maana ya "a knee".

misconceptions.ask: Ukibadilisha neno moja kwa jingine katika sentensi, maana inabaki ileile?
misconceptions.repair: Hapana. "koti" ni a coat, na "goti" ni a knee.

misconceptions.ask: Ni sauti gani zinarudiwa katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama p/b, t/d, k/g na ch/j, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ta-mu.

checks.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "a knee".
Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
checks.answer: Baba na bibi wanapika pilau na pombe ya bibi bila pilipili.
